sweep_time.unit: normalized; 3–150 ms exponential tau, onset latched

sweep.unit: normalized; 0–4 octave pitch rise, onset latched

decay.unit: normalized; 20 ms–1.8 s exponential tau, onset latched

wave.unit: categorical, paired reset/free: sine, asymmetric, triangle, sinetooth, saw, square

click.unit: normalized; squared transient gain, onset latched

drive.unit: normalized, live 3 ms smoothing and onset snap

gate.unit: boolean; rising edge triggers, fall does not choke

phase: reset/free phase selected by wave pairs; free phase requires continuous processing when silent
oversampling: not built into kernel; high-rate diagnostic only
